purpose: Q17 整体性能与体验验收：生产构建、四页加载、长历史、示例图表、地图热力开关；3 次本机观察的中位数

environment.server: scripts/serve_web.py, isolated project home, clean CI venv
environment.long_history: Playwright route fixture: 24 messages, 38,643 characters, explicitly synthetic

method.route_load: new browser context per route, networkidle + 500 ms
method.long_history: history endpoint replaced with synthetic fixture; all other APIs real
method.sample_charts: real S01 load + charts page + 1.8 s settle
method.heat_toggle: click label twice, wait two requestAnimationFrame calls
method.metrics: navigation timing, resource transfer/decoded bytes, DOM nodes, longtask entries, scroll height, scroll position
method.note: Numbers are observations on one machine/build/data; not thresholds, FPS, or cross-device guarantees

heat_toggle.change: heat layer cached; hide/show via canvas display instead of remove/re-add and re-rasterize
heat_toggle.note: Each timing includes two requestAnimationFrame waits (roughly one to two frames); compare before/after, not as pure JS work

node_benchmark.scope: synthetic screen-space CPU workload; not FPS or field accuracy

overall_acceptance.four_routes: chat/charts/river/tech loaded; no console errors in observations
overall_acceptance.q16_workbench: four-state strip present; RAG success and failure retry documented separately
overall_acceptance.readability: 17 checks passed at 320/390/768/1280 and 200%; no horizontal overflow
overall_acceptance.q13_q15: existing context, side thread, cards and investigation tests remain green
overall_acceptance.status: Q17 local controlled performance/profile acceptance; real-user, screen-reader, real-device and field performance remain unverified

limitations: Long history is a synthetic route fixture, not a real model report or real project history.
External map tiles and network affect chart/map load; not a controlled network benchmark.
3 runs are enough for median/max here, but not stable p95 or cross-device percentiles.
Charts still show 90 ms max long task after optimization; recorded, not hidden.
No real screen reader, physical touch device, Safari, Firefox, low-end hardware or field data.
